title: Bye Bye (Mewing)
blurb: Somebody asks a question, a finger goes to the lips, the jawline is indicated — cannot talk, mewing. The gesture swept TikTok on the back of a genuinely strange corner of the internet obsessed with jaw posture, and it became the perfect non-answer, a refusal to engage dressed up as discipline. This clip is its voice. Play it to exit any conversation with maximum unserious commitment, especially one where you have been asked something reasonable and have quietly decided not to deal with it. Peak gesture-meme culture, correctly preserved.
